prompt: Origin: first frame of docs/media/hero.mp4, upscaled to 2508x1412 (lanczos) and encoded with cwebp q76. hero.mp4 is derived with ffmpeg (4 s crossfade loop, brightness -0.06, saturation 0.8, a hue shift that turns the amber and lime LEDs green, 1920x1080, crf 24, no audio) from a Higgsfield bytedance/seedance-2.5 text-to-video clip, 5 s, 1080p, 16:9, generated 2026-11-03, whose uneven frames 78 to 94 were retimed with VideoToolbox frame interpolation (see made_by), with the prompt: Cinematic slow dolly forward down a narrow data center cold aisle at 2 a.m.: tall black server racks on both sides with tiny green status LEDs blinking, one amber LED blinking on the right, cool dim overhead light falling off into darkness at the end of the aisle, perforated floor tiles, shallow depth of field, realistic 35mm film look, moody and quiet. No text, no signs, no labels, no people, no screens, no neon glow.
made_by: 1. Higgsfield bytedance/seedance-2.5/text-to-video, resolution 1080p, duration 5, aspect_ratio 16:9, the prompt above -> higgsfield.mp4 (HEVC Main 10, 1920x1080, 121 frames at 24 fps, bt709, with an audio track that is dropped below).

2. In higgsfield.mp4, frames 79, 82, 85, 88, 91 and 94 repeat the frame before and the frames after them jump to catch up (per-frame image shift 0 to 18.6 px against about 7 elsewhere). Frames 78 to 94 were rebuilt at even spacing (about 6.99 px per frame between the real frames 77 and 95, measured by phase correlation in both side LED fields) with VideoToolbox VTFrameRateConversion (macOS 26, quality priority), each one interpolated between the two real frames around its target position; frames 0 to 77 and 95 to 120 are untouched. Result: fixed.mov (ProRes 422 HQ, 10 bit, bt709), 121 frames, steps 5.7 to 8.4 px across frames 70 to 100.
